title: Christ is Superior to Moses
theme: Christ’s superior faithfulness and position call God’s house to confidence and warn against unbelief.
proposition: Because Christ is superior to Moses, we must hold fast our confidence and beware of unbelief.
sermonQuestion: What does Hebrews 3 teach us about faithful life in Christ?
